weaknesses: The abstract misrepresents the contributions by discussing CRISPR-Cas9, which is unrelated to the main topic of conformal risk control.
The claims of novelty are overstated, as the proposed method closely resembles existing approaches in conformal prediction without sufficient differentiation.
Key assumptions regarding the monotonicity of loss functions are not adequately discussed, potentially limiting the applicability of the proposed method.
strengths: The paper presents a clear and structured approach to extending conformal prediction, which is a relevant area of research.
The theoretical foundations are rigorously developed, providing a solid basis for the proposed method.
Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the conformal risk control algorithm across various tasks, showcasing its practical applicability.
